name: @haoking/opencvjs
description: OpenCV 5.0.0 WebAssembly build with an extended Mat operation layer

scripts.bench: ls test/bench/*.bench.js >/dev/null && for f in test/bench/*.bench.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.prepack: test -f dist/index.js && test -f dist/index.d.ts && test -f dist/baseline/opencv_js.wasm && test -f dist/simd/opencv_js.wasm || { echo '❌ dist/ is not assembled or lacks a variant: the npm package must contain both dist/baseline/ (the fallback for engines without WebAssembly SIMD) and dist/simd/. Run npm run assemble <baseline dir> <simd dir> first.'; exit 1; } && for f in src/js/*.js; do cmp -s "$f" "dist/${f##*/}" || { echo "❌ dist/ is out of sync with src/js/ ($f): run npm run assemble first, or the package ships the old extension layer"; exit 1; }; done

author: Haochen Wang
